description: Setup POST returns 201 and echoes the discount; the persisted order has no discount applied.
howSeeded: Removed the discount mapping from OrderEntity while leaving the response DTO untouched.
decidingEvidence: The 201 on the setup POST echoing the discount, against a stored record with the discount dropped.
twinAxis: Also surfaces as a bad fixture, but the setup call reported success and the product persisted it wrongly.
